title: About
h1: Not an agency. A partner that runs the business as a whole.
lead: We start with an audit, including the financials. We define the core of the business. We build the system: websites, CRM, telephony, AI. We package it: brand, content, PR. We bring in clients: advertising and SEO. We support the deals: tenders and legal.

approach.text: Business, market, product, data and processes.

approach.name: Core

approach.name: System

approach.name: Growth

geoLead: Team and projects across Europe, Ukraine, Kazakhstan and Asia.
teamLead: Behind every CYBERMOVE project are people with real operating experience — from strategy and brand launches to AI automation, tenders and legal support.
metricsLead: We measure results in the business’s money, not in reach and clicks. Baselines are recorded before work starts so there is something to compare with, and we agree which metrics matter most for your task.

metrics.d: Channel spend for the period divided by the number of leads it produced. It shows what an enquiry from each source really costs.
All marketing and sales spend for the period divided by the number of new customers. Cheap leads mean nothing if a customer ends up expensive.
The share that moves between funnel steps: visitor to lead, lead to meeting, meeting to payment. It shows at which step the money is lost.
The revenue or margin a customer brings over the whole relationship. Together with CAC it tells you how much you can spend on acquisition.
Channel income minus channel spend, divided by the spend. Calculated for each channel separately, so paying channels are scaled and the rest switched off.
How much the business earns after direct costs and whether there is enough cash for growth every month. Without it, revenue growth can end in a cash gap.
